summary.text: Bob Cote is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 16, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An environmental engineer by career, he says he would represent Londonderry and has listed opposing a broad income or sales tax among his campaign messages.

paragraphs.text: Bob Cote earned a high school diploma from Manchester Memorial High School and a bachelor's degree from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute in 1970.
His career experience includes working as an environmental engineer.

In his 2026 Ballotpedia survey answers, Cote said New Hampshire should oppose a broad income tax or sales tax and that a limited education-funding income tax should be considered only if voters approve it at the ballot box.
He also said the state should work toward a fairer, more predictable way to fund public education and should defend local control and avoid unfunded mandates on towns.
He listed housing, climate and environment, taxes, education, energy, and local businesses and local government among his areas of policy interest.
